summary: Linear search over an array of 8-byte {commandID, param} pairs stored in the AI command queue (buffer pointer at this+0x44A8, entry count at this+0x44B0). Returns 1 if a pair's first dword equals a2, otherwise 0. Called by CommandQueueResponseHandler for duplicate-command detection.

operations.description: Read queue entry count from this+0x44B0. If negative, the queue is empty, so no duplicate is possible: return 0 immediately.
Load the queue buffer pointer stored at this+0x44A8 as the scan base; each element is an 8-byte {commandID, param} pair.
Scan pairs with 8-byte stride, comparing the first dword of each pair against a2.
Increment probe index and compare against the count at this+0x44B0; if the probe exceeds the count, the search is exhausted and 0 is returned.
Return 1 when a matching command ID is found; CommandQueueResponseHandler consumes this as a deduplication signal before enqueueing a command.

unresolved: The command-queue interpretation of fields 0x44A8/0x44B0 is inferred from the caller name CommandQueueResponseHandler; not independently proven.
How the caller consumes the duplicate result is not visible from this function.
